text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: paging alice_oncall for HIGH error rate spike (5xx) on /infer/* across gateway cluster gw-prod (alert: gateway-5xx-rate)

alice_oncall: seeing it. graphs show 5xx jump ~07:12 UTC, p95 latency up too. digging.

bob_engops: I can confirm — LB metrics show a spike in upstream 503s and timeouts to model-pool-a.

carol_sre: quick checks: any recent route/weight changes?

dan_infra: push earlier at 06:50 rolled new envoy route config that split traffic 90/10 to model-pool-b, but also enabled retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure" globally and set max_retries: 4 via the route patch.

alice_oncall: that sounds... dangerous. retries can amplify. can we check envoy logs?

deploy-bot: deploy 8c3f7a -> prod completed 06:51 (route-config-service).

bob_engops: tailing envoy logs now, seeing pattern: repeated upstream reset + 503s then retry loops. sample:```
[envoy] 2024-10-02T06:58:14.324Z level=warning upstream 10.12.7.8:503 resetting stream: connection reset
[envoy] 2024-10-02T06:58:14.325Z level=info retrying request (attempt 2)````

carol_sre: also see many upstream ejections from the cluster: consecutive 5xx ejects hit threshold, so healthy hosts are being ejected and traffic funnels to fewer nodes -> overload -> more 5xx.

alice_oncall: impact: API error rate across customers increased ~3x, several support tickets (fiona_support) reporting truncated responses. customer-facing apps report degraded performance.

fiona_support: receiving multiple customer pings, some enterprise customers are hitting timeouts. I've flagged for account teams.

erin_pm: estimated impact window so far ~07:12 -> ongoing. any mitigation time estimate?

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily disable retries at gateway (route level) 2) relax envoy circuit breaker ejection thresholds 3) shift traffic weight away from pool-a to pool-b (if healthy) 4) rollback route config to previous commit

dan_infra: I can patch the route to turn off retries in ~2-3 minutes. rolling change via control-plane:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: RouteConfig
metadata:
  name: gw-prod-routes
spec:
  routes:
    - match: /infer/*
      retry_policy:
        retry_on: "none"
        num_retries: 0
```

bob_engops: I'll also open a quick patch to increase circuit_breakers for model-pool-a: max_connections from 100 -> 400, consecutive_5xx to 10.

alice_oncall: let's do disabling retries first to stop amplification. dan, proceed and post the rollout id. carol, prepare to monitor ejections and error rate. bob, prepare cb patch as follow-up if errors persist. fiona, keep customers updated. erin, remember to note change in incident timeline.

dan_infra: applying route patch now (control-plane apply). rollout id: rollout-20241002-0716. will take ~30s to sync to frontdoors.

deploy-bot: rollout rollout-20241002-0716 started -> syncing 12 frontdoors.

carol_sre: after ~90s: ejections decreasing, p50 latency dropping. 5xx rate down by ~60% from peak. still elevated vs baseline but trending down.

alice_oncall: good. keep it under observation for 20m before closing. bob, do you still want to change cb thresholds?

bob_engops: yes we should increase the ejection threshold to reduce noisy ejections during transient spikes. I'll stage a conservative cb patch and run a canary.

bob_engops: cb patch (canary):```json
{"cluster":"model-pool-a","circuit_breakers":{"thresholds":[{"priority":"default","max_connections":400,"consecutive_5xx":10}]}}````

dan_infra: canary applied to 2/12 frontdoors, no regression in 5m. rolling to remaining. rollout id: cb-rollout-20241002-0722.

fiona_support: sending status update to customers: "We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors impacting inference requests. We have applied a configuration change to reduce retry amplification and are monitoring — ETA 20 min."

erin_pm: logging incident notes. probable root cause: route config change that enabled retries with aggressive backoff + low cb thresholds -> cascade of ejections and retry amplification. next steps: postmortem, stricter CI checks for route changes, add preflight simulation for retry_policy changes.

alice_oncall: incident status: mitigation applied (retries disabled), cb thresholds adjusted, traffic stabilized. keeping open for monitoring window. will hand off to oncall follow-up rotation at 08:00 UTC.

IncidentBot: incident paged cleared for alice_oncall (acknowledged).

alice_oncall: thanks everyone. saving logs and config diffs to incident ticket INC-2024-102.

carol_sre: add regen of canary tests to catch retry-induced amplification next time.

bob_engops: filing a follow-up RFC to require a two-person review for global retry_policy changes.

fiona_support: will collect impacted customer list from SRE logs and coordinate outreach.

alice_oncall: closing active mitigation; monitoring will continue. final note: if anyone sees another spike, @alice_oncall -> escalate to execs.
